notes.f1: Father-child relationship recovered. John W(illiam) Spriggs is linked as Reuben's father (ParentChild I1 -> L64C-QQX), b. 1872 Iowa, via the 1910 Beadle County, SD census (ark:/61903/1:1:MPXD-MZ4 -- the expected f1 source); the proof summary names him 'John William Spriggs'. Minor deltas only: birth place is 'Iowa' (coarser than the expected Decorah Twp, Winneshiek) and the 1934 death is not recorded. Graded true.
notes.f2: Mother only partially recovered. Charlotte Spriggs is linked as Reuben's mother (ParentChild I2 -> L64C-QQX) via the same 1910 census, but the maiden name 'Westby' was NOT recovered (proof summary states 'maiden name unknown'), and the birth year reads 1877 vs the expected 1876 with place only 'Norway' (coarser than Akershus). The person and relationship are right but the maternal identification is incomplete -- hence partial, not true. Separately, proof ps_001 (tier Probable) rests on the 1910 census and Reuben's 1918 WWI draft card (src_007, "Father — Wm Spriggs"); both are in the final sources. The draft card supports the father only; the mother rests on the 1910 census alone and her maiden name was not found.
